name: Airbyte
description: Airbyte is an open-source data integration platform that moves data through ELT pipelines from 600+ connectors into data warehouses, lakes, and other destinations, available both as self-hosted open-source software and as a fully managed Airbyte Cloud service.
best_for: Data teams that want an open-source-first ELT platform they can self-host for free, with the option to move to a fully managed cloud service as data volume, governance, or support needs grow.
features: 600+ pre-built connectors spanning SaaS applications, databases, APIs, warehouses, and data lakes
No-code Connector Builder for creating custom integrations without waiting on a vendor-built connector
Multiple sync modes, including full refresh, incremental append, and log-based change data capture (CDC)
Automated schema change detection and handling
Built-in observability with sync health dashboards, record counts, and latency tracking
Native orchestration integrations with Airflow, Prefect, and Dagster, plus first-class dbt support for transformations
Multiple ways to manage pipelines: UI, Terraform provider, API, and Python SDK
A queryable context store that lets AI agents draw on data synced through the same connector catalog
pros: The Core edition is open source and can be self-hosted at no cost, not just a time-limited trial
Airbyte Cloud's Standard plan has a published starting price ($10/month) rather than requiring a sales call to get started
Airbyte Cloud is SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001:2017 certified and states GDPR compliance
cons: Pro and Enterprise Flex Cloud plans use custom, capacity-based pricing that requires contacting sales — no published numeric rate above the entry Standard plan
Getting the open-source Core edition for free means running and maintaining the infrastructure yourself, rather than a managed service

pricing.starting_price: Self-hosted Core edition is free (open source); managed Airbyte Cloud's Standard plan starts at $10/month on a volume-based rate

tiers.name: Core (Self-Managed)
tiers.notes: Open-source edition you deploy and run yourself; always free, but you provide and maintain the infrastructure.

tiers.name: Standard
tiers.notes: Fully managed Airbyte Cloud, starting at $10/month with volume-based pricing beyond the base. Includes 600+ connectors, CDC, schema propagation, column selection, and syncs as frequent as hourly.

tiers.name: Pro
tiers.notes: Capacity-based pricing via Data Workers. Adds 15-minute syncs, custom mappings, multiple workspaces, SSO, RBAC, field hashing/encryption, row filtering, premium support, and multiple data regions. Requires contacting sales.

tiers.name: Enterprise Flex
tiers.notes: Adds sovereign data movement, on-premises and multi-region deployment, and a hybrid model with a managed control plane. Capacity-based pricing; requires contacting sales.

alternatives.name: Fivetran
alternatives.description: A fully managed ELT platform with a large pre-built connector catalog and automated schema drift handling, priced on monthly active rows rather than open-source self-hosting.
alternatives.best_for: Teams that want a fully managed, low-maintenance ELT service and are comfortable with usage-based (MAR) pricing rather than an open-source, self-hostable option.
strengths: Large pre-built connector catalog (700+ on Standard)
Free plan up to 500K monthly active rows

faq.question: Is Airbyte free?
faq.answer: Airbyte's Core edition is open source and free to self-host on your own infrastructure. Airbyte also offers a fully managed Airbyte Cloud service, where the Standard plan starts at $10/month on volume-based pricing, plus Pro and Enterprise Flex plans with custom, capacity-based pricing.

faq.question: What's the difference between self-hosted Airbyte and Airbyte Cloud?
faq.answer: Self-hosted Core is the open-source edition you deploy and operate yourself at no license cost. Airbyte Cloud is Airbyte's fully managed service, adding hosting, faster sync frequencies, SSO/RBAC, premium support, and (on Enterprise Flex) sovereign or hybrid deployment options.

faq.question: Is Airbyte Cloud compliant with security standards?
faq.answer: Airbyte states that Airbyte Cloud is SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001:2017 certified and GDPR compliant, according to its own product pages.
